faqs.question: How do I know this charger fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the wattage and connector type. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your original charger or your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is a higher-wattage charger safe to use?
faqs.answer: Yes — a charger rated higher than your laptop's original wattage is safe; your laptop only draws what it needs. A lower-wattage charger should be avoided.
